state_and_generators.draw_order: draw eps shape (800,6) in variable order, then eta length 800; unused eta is still drawn

representations.R1: z-score, ddof=0, scale<=1e-12 maps to zero
representations.R3: average ranks; p=(rank-.5)/600 clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6]; NormalDist inverse CDF
representations.application_order: transform each full retained series before lag alignment

detector.normalized_hsic: column-center RFF matrices; ||Cxy||_F^2/sqrt(||Cxx||_F^2*||Cyy||_F^2), denominator<=1e-15 maps to zero
detector.channel_storage: linear and nonlinear pair/lag scores are computed and retained separately
detector.combined_pair_score: max over lags and over the two channels

capacity_ladder.ensemble_rule: mean of the four independently seeded normalized-HSIC scores at each pair and lag

conformal.calibration_null: fresh independent draws from G_null; no block permutation
conformal.evaluation_null: fresh independent draws from G_null; no block permutation
conformal.familywise_max: maximum over all 15 pairs and seven lags for the relevant channel set

phase0c.primary_exchangeability_gate: same G_null generator and disjoint deterministic namespaces; permutation prohibited

phase0r.freshness: capacity is fixed before a disjoint confirmatory namespace is opened
phase0r.global_broad_mode: at least 8 of 15 combined pair p-values are <=0.05
phase0r.localization: target H-V is significant and is the unique maximum pair score in the relevant channel
phase0r.phase_pass: at least three of four representations pass every gate
decision_precedence: if fewer than three representations pass the null gate: STOP_NULL_CALIBRATION_INVALID
else if fewer than three pass all square nonlinear and square linear-control gates: STOP_NONLINEAR_DETECTOR_INADEQUATE
else if fewer than three pass all gates: STOP_REPRESENTATION_INSTABILITY

seed_mapping.algorithm: UTF-8 canonical string -> SHA256 -> first 8 bytes unsigned big-endian uint64

phase1a_rule: enter only on PHASE_0R_PASS; otherwise qualified theories and candidate edges remain zero
